2025

2025 · Publication

PDRS at IEEE SMC 2025

Our work on PDRS, a self-contained inertial positioning module for wearable navigation, was published in the proceedings of IEEE SMC 2025.

Paper and manuscript

2024

2024 · Publication

Real-time pedestrian dead reckoning at IEEE SMC 2024

Our paper on real-time pedestrian dead reckoning for an IoT-based positioning platform was published at IEEE SMC 2024. The work brings motion estimation onto embedded hardware to reduce communication with the positioning server.

Integrated indoor–outdoor positioning featured on KBS and TJB

Our research team introduced an integrated indoor–outdoor positioning system using AI and IoT. The work was featured in news reports by KBS and TJB.
